notes:
The tool is told now instead of asking. RecCheck's helper is already running and already watches protel's windows, so the moment you open the in-house list, the move window, the arrival report or the departure report it reads it there and then. Nothing polls protel any more.

That means a list you open for two seconds still lands — the rows are taken when the window opens, so they survive it closing. And the departure report is read when you open one, which is when it changes, rather than on any schedule.

Room moves are recorded too, but only the ones protel has put its X against. A move without one raises an alert instead, because protel will not show it either.
